board._src: FACTS §3.1 + ADDENDUM §1: only the allowed ads figures (9.3 % CTR and 703 clicks 21 Apr – 27 Jul 2026; ≈8.5–10 % typical CTR vs ≈6 % sector; 19 leads and 430 clicks 8–23 Oct 2026; 170+ negative keywords). No euro figure about the ads, no baseline, no derived ratio. The turnover sentence lives once in about.body (B1), never here.

ctr.tCap: Click-through rate: this campaign compared with the construction-sector average
ctr.back: Responsive search ads · exact- and phrase-match keywords · 170+ negative keywords · landing pages that match each ad

clicks.back: Location targeting: a radius around Mollet plus nearby towns · weekly search-term reviews

leads.period: <time datetime="2026-10-08">8</time>–<time datetime="2026-10-23">23 Oct 2026</time> · clean measurement period
leads.back: Measured with Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 and Consent Mode v2

disc.back: Every week I read the real search terms and block the ones that don't fit

csp.s1: Google Ads recorded far fewer conversions than the leads that really arrived (Sep 2026: 4 conversions recorded vs about 20 real leads)
csp.s2: the site's Content-Security-Policy blocked the tracking
csp.s3: added the missing hash and origins to the policy; tracking moved to Consent Mode v2
csp.s4: verified in production: the conversion requests go through
csp.tech: Found in DevTools: script-src lacked the inline script's SHA-256 hash and googletagmanager.com; later, connect-src lacked Google's conversion endpoints (pagead2.googlesyndication.com, www.google.com, ad.doubleclick.net).
csp.fixed: policy fixed: the tracking gets through
csp.back: I traced the missing conversions to the site's Content-Security-Policy, changed the policy so the tracking could run, and checked that conversions were recorded again.
csp.readout: Incident: conversions blocked by the CSP · fixed

match.cap: The pattern behind each ad (illustrative, not a real ad)
match.back: Each ad leads to a landing page that matches it, so people land on what they searched for. The site has landing pages per service and per town.
match.readout: Message match: search → ad → landing page
